title: Injection/Cross Site Scripting potential in SvnStyleDiffProvider in Apache JSPWIKI 3.0.0 on all platforms allows…
description: Apache JSPWIKI 3.0.0 contains a vulnerability in the SvnStyleDiffProvider component that allows injection and cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks. This issue permits improperly formatted content to be rendered in the browser, potentially enabling JavaScript-based exploits. The vulnerability is fixed in version 3.0.1.
